title: Paper Instruments in Early African Economies and the Debated Role of the Suftaja

passages.note: The author reports a source dated 346 AH/958 CE in which an Egyptian tax officer issues a 33-dinar suftaja for future land tax. Related evidence shows redemption was not assured. The primary document was not inspected.
